company.name: Astra Tech
company.shortDescription: Astra Tech is a technology company and investment group that operates a group of digital services, mainly in fintech and communication.
company.description: Astra Tech develops and manages a connected digital ecosystem focused on communication, fintech, and everyday digital services. It operates a platform centered around the Botim application, which combines messaging, voice, and video communication with financial tools such as payments, transfers, credit, and savings features. The company also works on integrated financial services through its subsidiaries, including lending and microfinancing solutions, as well as digital payment systems for individuals and businesses. Its approach is based on consolidating multiple services into a single platform to reduce the need for separate apps for communication and financial tasks. The company also develops infrastructure and tools that support AI-enabled services and digital transactions across its ecosystem.
